data_objects.name: ephemeris_positions
data_objects.meaning: Time-indexed Cartesian ephemeris positions represented with both Julian-date and calendar-date forms on the TDB time scale.
data_objects.notes: The final source column is an empty trailing field.

variables.name: JDTDB
variables.meaning: Julian Date on the Barycentric Dynamical Time scale.

variables.name: Calendar Date (TDB)
variables.meaning: Calendar rendering of the same ephemeris epoch on the TDB time scale.

variables.name: X
variables.meaning: Cartesian X position coordinate in an unspecified reference frame and distance unit.

variables.name: Y
variables.meaning: Cartesian Y position coordinate in an unspecified reference frame and distance unit.

variables.name: Z
variables.meaning: Cartesian Z position coordinate in an unspecified reference frame and distance unit.

variables.name: Unnamed: 5
variables.meaning: Empty trailing CSV field with no supplied semantic content.

structure.description: Each row is one ephemeris epoch; JDTDB and Calendar Date (TDB) are dual representations of that epoch, not separate observations.
Rows are ordered by increasing epoch at regular daily intervals, with X, Y, and Z aligned to each epoch.

uncertainties: The observed body, coordinate origin, reference frame, and X/Y/Z distance unit are not declared.
No semantics are supplied for the empty trailing column.
annotation_notes: Only the declared train.csv and its neutral packet were used as evidence.
